answer: Escrowed Reputation Decay: each new identity must post a refundable atlas deposit that decays only while its owner stays honest; any clone linked by shared behavior loses the deposit. A fable hash ties every action to its funding source, so splitting identities multiplies locked capital. An honest agent keeps one yarrow token refreshed per epoch; a sybil farmer pays that deposit per clone and forfeits it on detection. Cloning thus costs N deposits versus one for honest participation.
